SetCasterConfig.description_en: Configures detailed settings for a production studio, including the name, transcoding configuration, recording configuration, and other parameters
SetCasterConfig.description_zh: 调用本接口对导播台进行详细配置，包括导播台的名称、转码配置、录制配置等参数信息

SetCasterSceneConfig.description_en: Sets the full scene configuration for a production studio by clearing the existing scene configuration and applying layout information to the specified scene
SetCasterSceneConfig.description_zh: 全量设置场景配置，清空场景配置，并将布局信息设置并生效至指定场景

SetLiveDomainCertificate.description_en: Configures whether the certificate feature is enabled for a domain name and modifies certificate information
SetLiveDomainCertificate.description_zh: 设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及修改证书信息

SetLiveDomainMultiStreamConfig.description_en: Calls SetLiveDomainMultiStreamConfig to enable or disable the dual-stream disaster recovery switch
SetLiveDomainMultiStreamConfig.description_zh: 调用 SetLiveDomainMultiStreamConfig 设置开启双流灾备开关

SetLiveDomainMultiStreamMaster.description_en: Manually switches between the active stream and standby stream
SetLiveDomainMultiStreamMaster.description_zh: 手动切换双流灾备主流

SetLiveDomainMultiStreamOptimalMode.description_en: Sets the automatic mode switch for dual-stream disaster recovery
SetLiveDomainMultiStreamOptimalMode.description_zh: 设置双流灾备自动模式开关

SetLiveDomainStagingConfig.description_en: Sets or modifies domain configurations in the canary release environment
SetLiveDomainStagingConfig.description_zh: 调用SetLiveDomainStagingConfig设置或修改灰度环境下的域名配置

SetLiveEdgeTransfer.description_en: Calls SetLiveEdgeTransfer to configure live stream relay settings
SetLiveEdgeTransfer.description_zh: 调用SetLiveEdgeTransfer设置直播转推配置

SetLiveMpuTaskSei.description_en: Configures custom supplemental enhancement information (SEI) for co-streaming

SetLiveStreamBlock.description_en: Sets stream-level blocking for live streams by calling SetLiveStreamBlock
SetLiveStreamBlock.description_zh: 调用SetLiveStreamBlock设置直播流粒度封禁

SetLiveStreamDelayConfig.description_en: You can call SetLiveStreamDelayConfig to configure live streaming latency

SetLiveStreamPreloadTasks.description_en: Sets live stream prefetch tasks. You can prefetch up to 100 live streams in a batch
SetLiveStreamPreloadTasks.description_zh: 设置直播预热任务，支持批量设置直播流预热

SetLiveStreamsNotifyUrlConfig.description_en: Sets the stream ingest callback configuration

SetShowListBackground.description_en: Sets the background for a playlist mode production studio

SetSnapshotCallbackAuth.description_zh: 设置截图回调鉴权配置

StartCaster.description_en: Starts a production studio. If the PVW and PGM scenes do not exist, they are created. The PVW and PGM scenes are started, and the underlying audio and video processing tasks are initiated
StartCaster.description_zh: 启动导播台。若PVW、PGM场景不存在则创建，启动PVW、PGM场景，启动底层音视频处理任务

StartCasterScene.description_en: Starts a specified Program View (PVW) scene. This operation is used to start preview scenes
StartCasterScene.description_zh: 启动指定场景，限制仅用于PVW的打开

StartLiveDomain.description_en: Starts a disabled live streaming domain. This operation changes the DomainStatus to online
StartLiveDomain.description_zh: 启用状态为停用的直播域名，将DomainStatus变更为online

StartLiveMPUTask.description_en: Creates a stream mixing and transcoding task

StartRtcCloudRecording.description_en: Starts an RTC cloud recording task

StopCaster.description_en: Stops a production studio. This stops the PVW (preview scene) and PGM (program output scene) scenes
StopCaster.description_zh: 停止导播台。停止PVW（预览场景）、PGM（正式输出场景）场景

StopCasterScene.description_zh: 停止指定场景，限制仅用于停止PVW场景（预览场景）

StopLiveDomain.description_en: Disables a live streaming domain. This operation changes the DomainStatus to offline
StopLiveDomain.description_zh: 停用状态为启用的直播域名，将DomainStatus变更为offline

StopLiveMPUTask.description_en: Stops a stream mixing and forwarding task

StopRtcAsrTask.description_zh: 调用StopRtcAsrTask停止实时字幕任务

StopRtcCloudRecording.description_en: Stops an RTC cloud recording task

TagLiveResources.description_en: Adds labels to ApsaraVideo Live resources by calling TagLiveResources

UnTagLiveResources.description_en: Calls UnTagLiveResources to delete tags from ApsaraVideo Live resources

UpdateCasterResourceGroup.description_en: Updates the resource group of a production studio
UpdateCasterResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用UpdateCasterResourceGroup更新导播台所在资源组

UpdateCasterSceneAudio.description_en: Modifies the audio configurations of a scene. This operation also lets you add an audio configuration or apply an existing audio configuration to a new scene
UpdateCasterSceneAudio.description_zh: 增加场景音频配置，将原场景音频添加到新场景

UpdateCasterSceneConfig.description_en: Modifies a scene, including the layout, without invalidating the previous configurations. This operation is more efficient than the SetCasterSceneConfig operation
UpdateCasterSceneConfig.description_zh: 增量设置场景配置，不清空原配置，布局信息在原场景上增量修改，效率较全量设置高

UpdateCustomLiveStreamTranscode.description_zh: 更新自定义转码配置信息

UpdateEventSub.description_en: Updates a callback that is used to subscribe to channel or user events
UpdateEventSub.description_zh: 更新订阅房间消息回调

UpdateLiveAISubtitle.description_en: Updates a subtitle template by calling UpdateLiveAISubtitle

UpdateLiveAppRecordConfig.description_en: Updates a live stream recording configuration that saves the output to Object Storage Service (OSS)
UpdateLiveAppRecordConfig.description_zh: 更新配置APP录制，输出内容保存到OSS中

UpdateLiveAppSnapshotConfig.description_en: Modifies a snapshot configuration of a streaming domain. The captured snapshots are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS). The modification takes effect after you restart stream ingest
UpdateLiveAppSnapshotConfig.description_zh: 更新直播流下的截图配置。输出内容保存到OSS中，重新推流后生效

UpdateLiveAudioAuditConfig.description_en: Updates the voice content moderation configuration for live streaming
UpdateLiveAudioAuditConfig.description_zh: 更新直播语音审核配置

UpdateLiveAudioAuditNotifyConfig.description_en: Updates the callback configuration for automated audio review
UpdateLiveAudioAuditNotifyConfig.description_zh: 更新直播语音审核回调配置信息

UpdateLiveCenterTransfer.description_en: Updates the live center transfer configuration by calling UpdateLiveCenterTransfer
UpdateLiveCenterTransfer.description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveCenterTransfer修改直播中心转推配置

UpdateLiveDelayConfig.description_en: Updates the live stream delay configuration

UpdateLiveDetectNotifyConfig.description_en: Modifies the configuration of callbacks for video moderation results. As a result, the callback URL that is used to receive the callback notifications is changed
UpdateLiveDetectNotifyConfig.description_zh: 更新直播审核回调通知地址

UpdateLivePackageConfig.description_zh: 调用UpdateLivePackageConfig更新直播封装配置

UpdateLivePullStreamInfoConfig.description_en: Updates the configuration of live stream pulling, including the addresses of the origin server, start time, and end time
UpdateLivePullStreamInfoConfig.description_zh: 更新直播拉流配置信息，包括源站地址、开始时间和结束时间

UpdateLivePullToPush.description_en: Updates a stream pulling task by calling UpdateLivePullToPush
UpdateLivePullToPush.description_zh: 调用UpdateLivePullToPush更新拉流转推任务

UpdateLiveRecordNotifyConfig.description_en: Updates the domain-level recording callback configuration
UpdateLiveRecordNotifyConfig.description_zh: 更新域名级别录制回调配置

UpdateLiveRecordVodConfig.description_zh: 更新直播录制转点播配置

UpdateLiveSnapshotDetectPornConfig.description_en: Updates the content moderation configuration for live streaming

UpdateLiveStreamMonitor.description_en: Updates the configurations of a monitoring session

UpdateLiveStreamTranscode.description_zh: 更新通用转码配置信息

UpdateMessageApp.description_en: Call UpdateMessageApp to update interactive message application information
UpdateMessageApp.description_zh: 调用UpdateMessageApp更新互动消息应用信息

UpdateMessageGroup.description_en: You can call the UpdateMessageGroup operation to update message group information

UpdateRtcCloudRecording.description_en: Updates an RTC cloud recording task

UpdateRtcMPUEventSub.description_en: Updates a subscription to mixed-stream relay events
UpdateRtcMPUEventSub.description_zh: 更新混流转推事件订阅

UpdateRtsLiveStreamTranscode.description_en: Updates the configuration of a custom Real-time Streaming (RTS) transcoding template
UpdateRtsLiveStreamTranscode.description_zh: 更新RTS自定义转码配置信息

VerifyLiveDomainOwner.description_en: Verifies the ownership of a domain name
